answer: A bond must be split across 3 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Because each pulse escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the plume ledger records every share and the marble audit shows the split. Assembling that for 46 aliases means 46 times 3 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. That is 18 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
